descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# Play now in Early Access and claim your exclusive Villain!

Don’t miss your one chance to grab the Phantom Veil Mask—  a power that lets you fade through walls and vanish into thin air! Unlocks this September!
[media]

# Throw, smash, and crush anything you see
Who cares if they cry or get angry—this is a Villain’s world.
[media]

# A whole arsenal of superpowers is waiting for you
The moment you put on a mask, a new ability awakens, and you’ll go on a rampage as a completely different kind of Villain.
[media]

# Shoot guns, spread viruses, even drop poop gifts!
Your tools of chaos keep updating every week,  so there’s always a new way to make trouble.
[media]

# Clear missions to unlock brand-new stages of mayhem!
Office workers, yoga guys, even a two-legged horse—you’ll meet all sorts of weirdos.
[media]

# And then… some will dare to fight back
But remember, in this game, the Villain is the main character. The world where Villains win is the world you’ll create.
[media]

**For more rewards and events, join us on Discord!**

https://discord.gg/5AC5Et34Gs
